items.description: One large black wooden-bead chandelier with draped strands, rope-wrapped top ring, black bars and exposed warm bulbs
items.location: top left, hanging over the dining table

items.description: One white exterior door with a full glass lite, black hinges and a black lever handle with deadbolt, open view through glass; white trim casing
items.location: centre, upper middle, behind the table
items.beyond: Through the glass: sky, distant hills or mountains, neighbourhood houses, and a white deck railing with balusters

items.description: One tall white double-hung window with a lower sash grid-free, a dark roller shade pulled partway down at the top
items.beyond: Sky, dry grass field and a white deck railing outside

items.description: Tall white-framed windows stacked, with a transom-style upper window, partly seen on the far right
items.location: right edge, upper to middle, behind the plant
items.beyond: Light sky and plant leaves; little visible outside

items.description: One rectangular light-wood dining table with a thick block leg, cut off at left
Dark plum/burgundy velvet dining chairs with curved backs and thin black legs; about four clearly visible in foreground plus one more partly seen at far left behind the table
One cream upholstered chair or bench back visible behind the table at the far end
items.location: centre, behind the table beneath the door

items.description: One large white round pedestal bowl centrepiece filled with moss
Black and white striped area rug under the table
One tall faux rubber-plant tree with dark green and burgundy leaves in a white tapered planter with gold legs
items.location: right, middle to bottom, in front of the window

items.description: Black wire plant stand or small side stand, partly visible
items.location: bottom right, in front of the planter

items.description: White baseboard trim along the wall, light wood-look floor
Open wall edge/passage on the right leading to an adjacent space with tall windows and a high ceiling

edges: Left: the table, a window with shade and a chair are cut off by the frame edge. Right: the tall window and the plant are cut off. Top: the chandelier and the ceiling are cut off. Bottom: the chairs, the rug and the floor are cut off.
